happening.subject: anchor/node-row
happening.text: The warden comes down Tanner's Row before the fair.

happening.subject: anchor/node-smithy
happening.text: The warden steps in through the smithy's door, behind the counter.

objectives.hint: The new smithy is the first front on the row, its door beside the counter.
objectives.title: Step into the new smithy

happening.subject: anchor/node-square
happening.text: The warden stands in the square, by the fountain.

objectives.hint: The fountain square is the next place along the row.
objectives.title: Stand in the fountain square

happening.subject: anchor/node-stall
happening.text: The warden steps into the old stall.

objectives.hint: The old stall is further along the row, its door beside its counter.
objectives.title: Step into the old stall

happening.subject: anchor/node-ring
happening.text: The warden stands by the ring of stone in the old yard.

objectives.hint: The old well-yard is at the end of the row.
objectives.title: Stand in the old well-yard

on_complete.text: Every front on the row is seen.

effects.text: Tanner's Row. Look at each place on it before the fair: the new smithy, the fountain square, the old stall, and the old well-yard at the end.
